hooks.name: Keep specs honest
hooks.description: After the agent finishes a task, tick off completed spec tasks and record any behaviour that drifted from the requirements.

action.prompt: Review the changes made in this session. Update the checkboxes in the matching .kiro/specs/*/tasks.md, and if implemented behaviour differs from requirements.md, either update the requirement (with a short rationale) or open a TODO task. Keep edits minimal.
